approach: Add crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs (kept in athena-core, as the accepted reading says; athena-core cannot reach athena-cap-study). It has three pure checkers that take text and return problems, each run on the real file and on a mutated copy: (1) `rationale_problems(rationales, claims)` copies the production rules `incomplete_card` and `stated_without_source` (crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs:368-394, 419-432) exactly; (2) `readme_attribution_problems(readme)` needs the bundle name, its URL and the CC BY 4.0 license (README.md:322-324); (3) `design_attribution_problems(design)` needs docs/design/athena-v0.md §15 (line 1604): the license, the URL and the table with a `Departure, and why` column and its rows. A spec test follows buy_first.rs:176-191: `parse_spec`, `spec_gaps` holds no OLY-B-A3-02, `measure_problem` is None, the measure ends `status: not shown` and names the command. Fill the spec entry, add the CHANGELOG bullet, add the requirements-map note, and add the timing line the mirror rule requires.

decisions.choice: Copy the production rationale rules exactly into the athena-core test: a card is incomplete when decision, tradeoff or reversal_cost is blank, no alternative is non-blank, or provenance is not stated/evidenced/inferred; a `stated` card needs a non-blank quote on its own sources or on the sources of the claims it cites (claims.json). A `sources` array is NOT required on every card.
decisions.reason: These are the rules in crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs:368-394 (stated_without_source) and 419-432 (incomplete_card). The real data meets them: ra4 is `inferred` with `sources: []` (rationales.json:60-63), so criterion 2's 'at least one source' holds for the four stated cards (ra1, ra2, ra5, ra6) through a quoted source and for the evidenced ra3 through its own source, but NOT for ra4. The plan states this so the verifier does not read it as a miss; the study file is not edited.

rejected.option: Require a non-empty `sources` array on every card
rejected.why: Fails on the real file at ra4 (rationales.json:63) and disagrees with the production rule.

rejected.option: Put the test in crates/athena-cap-study/tests/ and call the production incomplete_card and stated_without_source
rejected.why: Valid, but the accepted reading and criteria 1-2 name crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs; moving it changes the deliverable path. The copy is small, cites the rules it copies, and the tests mutate real text so any drift on the fields checked shows.

rejected.option: Add a new check function in athena-core/src
rejected.why: Widens the change to src and the record checks; the brief asks for a test.

decisions.choice: Check attribution in two places: README.md (bundle name, URL, CC BY 4.0) and docs/design/athena-v0.md §15 (heading, license, URL, and the thesis table with a 'Departure, and why' header and at least one data row). State in the mechanism and CHANGELOG that whether each table row is true is a verifier judgement and not checked.
decisions.reason: The requirement asks that where the bundle shaped or did not shape a decision, that is recorded and attributed. README.md:327-328 sends the reader to §15, and §15 (athena-v0.md:1613-1625) is that record. Checking only three README strings is close to a word check (finding 5).

rejected.option: README check only, with the gap stated in prose
rejected.why: Leaves the per-decision record unchecked when a cheap structural check exists.

decisions.choice: The spec test follows buy_first.rs:176-191: parse_spec, spec_gaps without OLY-B-A3-02, measure_problem None, local owner and end-label checks, plus the file name and Hermes in the mechanism, and the test command in the measure. Add refusal cases for a `none` mechanism and a wrong label as buy_first.rs:193-209 does.
decisions.reason: spec_gaps and measure_problem (hestia.rs:1219) are what the Hestia sweep uses to queue this request again, so the test shows the sweep stops queuing it (finding 4).

rejected.option: Slice the spec text as model_roster.rs does
rejected.why: Does not run the production gap check.

decisions.choice: The measure ends `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded`. The mechanism states that Hermes has no study records, so what is learned from Hermes is not covered, and that the per-row truth of the §15 table is not checked.
decisions.reason: No line of `athena status` reports this property, so `not shown` is the only valid label (hestia.rs:1229-1235). The Hermes gap is in requirements-map.md:113 ('firstmate work handling only').

rejected.why: Out of scope; it changes status.rs and its tests.

It is a data file of estimates, not a governance, tool or lint file. It is an allowed exception to reading criterion 6 for that reason.

steps: Create crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs. Module docs name OLY-B-A3-02, the limits (Hermes has no study records; the truth of each §15 row is a verifier judgement) and the production rules copied. Add `repo_file` (as buy_first.rs:14-19), TEST_COMMAND = "cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded" and REQUIREMENT = "OLY-B-A3-02".

Add `rationale_problems(rationales: &str, claims: &str) -> Vec<String>`: parse both with serde_json; require a non-empty array; per card report a blank decision, tradeoff or reversal_cost, no non-blank alternative, a provenance not in stated/evidenced/inferred, and, for `stated` cards, no non-blank `quote` on the card's own sources or on the sources of the claims it cites by id. Do not require `sources` on every card (ra4 has none). Add `readme_attribution_problems(readme)` (bundle name, URL, `CC BY 4.0`) and `design_attribution_problems(design)` (the §15 heading, license, URL, the `Departure, and why` table header and at least one row below it).

Add the tests: real rationales pass (comment that ra4 is inferred with no sources); real README and design pass; mutations (tradeoff emptied, reversal_cost emptied, ra1 quote blanked with claims `[]`, README `[CC BY 4.0](...)` removed, design table header removed), each first asserting the target text is present; `spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism` and the refusal tests following buy_first.rs:176-231 (parse_spec, spec_gaps, measure_problem, local owner and end-label checks, file name and Hermes in the mechanism).

Edit docs/spec.toml lines 2543 and 2545 only. Mechanism: `A test, crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs, checks that every firstmate rationale record in studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json is complete by the study rules (decision, alternatives, tradeoff, reversal cost, provenance, and a quoted source for a stated card), and that README.md and docs/design/athena-v0.md section 15 attribute the harness-engineering bundle under CC BY 4.0. Hermes has no study records yet, so what Athena learns from Hermes is not covered; whether each row of the section 15 table is true is a verifier judgement and is not checked.` Measure: `Firstmate rationale records are complete and the bundle is attributed in the README and design section 15; cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded; status: not shown`. Leave owner, statement, kind, status and sources unchanged.
Add `athena-core --test learnings_recorded 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt between the external_calls_guard and model_roster lines (lines 53-54).

Add a bullet at the top of `### Added` under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, in the form of the lines near CHANGELOG.md:12-18: OLY-B-A3-02 has a mechanism (the test), what it checks, the Hermes gap, the unchecked per-row truth of §15, and `status: not shown`; no refusal rule and no config changes.

In docs/design/requirements-map.md line 113, add `crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs` to the 'where answered' column and keep `Partial: firstmate work handling only`, adding 'Hermes not studied'.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; fix any finding in the files above.

demonstrations.method: Integration test reads the real docs/spec.toml, parses it with parse_spec, finds OLY-B-A3-02, and runs the production gap and measure checks.
demonstrations.observes: mechanism is not `none` and contains `crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs` and `Hermes`; owner is `Athena`; measure_problem is None; the measure ends `status: not shown` and contains `cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded`; `spec_gaps` over the parsed spec holds no OLY-B-A3-02. On the base spec (mechanism `none`, label `status: requirement`) the first assertion fails.
demonstrations.fails_without: Reverting the spec entry to mechanism = "none" fails `assert_ne!(mechanism, "none")` and the spec_gaps assertion.
demonstrations.seam: Entry point: athena_core::hestia::{parse_spec, spec_gaps, measure_problem} (exist, hestia.rs:1219, imported as in buy_first.rs:8) on docs/spec.toml read through a `repo_file` helper copied from buy_first.rs:14-19. Step 1 adds the helper and the test. No fake. A second test, spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism, sets mechanism to `none` on the real parsed entry and asserts spec_gaps reports no_mechanism.

demonstrations.method: Call rationale_problems on the real studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json and claims.json text.
demonstrations.observes: The six records (ra1-ra6, counted in the file) give an empty problem list: each has a non-blank decision, tradeoff and reversal_cost, a non-blank alternative and a provenance of stated/evidenced/inferred; the stated cards ra1, ra2, ra5, ra6 each have a quoted source of their own. ra4 is inferred with `sources: []`, which the production rule allows; the plan therefore does not read 'at least one source' as holding for ra4, and the test says so in a comment.
demonstrations.fails_without: A checker that ignores the fields returns nothing on the mutated copies, so the criterion 4 tests fail; a checker that required sources on every card fails on ra4 here.
demonstrations.seam: rationale_problems(rationales_text, claims_text) -> Vec<String> in the test file (added by step 1), parsing with serde_json (a normal athena-core dependency, Cargo.toml:22), driven by the real files read with repo_file. Copies crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs:368-394 and 419-432. No double.

demonstrations.method: Call readme_attribution_problems on the real README.md and design_attribution_problems on the real docs/design/athena-v0.md. The third part, that the spec entry is not `none`, is shown by spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism (criterion 1).
demonstrations.observes: README.md names `Harness Engineering`, `https://github.com/lopopolo/harness-engineering` and `CC BY 4.0` (README.md:322-324); athena-v0.md has the §15 heading, the license, the URL, and the thesis table header `Departure, and why` with at least one row (lines 1604-1613). Both return empty problem lists.
demonstrations.fails_without: A README without the license, or a design file without the §15 table, returns problems; criterion 4 shows this.
demonstrations.seam: Two text-in, problems-out functions in the test file (added by step 1); real files read by repo_file. No double.

demonstrations.method: Mutation tests run the same checkers on edited copies of the real text, made with str::replace. Each first asserts that the target text is present in the real file, so a mutation that changes nothing cannot pass.
demonstrations.observes: (a) first `tradeoff` value emptied: rationale_problems names ra1 and its tradeoff; the real text gives none. (b) ra1's `reversal_cost` emptied: names ra1. (c) ra1's own quote blanked with claims text `[]`: names ra1 as stated without a quoted source, and only ra1. (d) README with the `[CC BY 4.0](...)` link removed: names the license. (e) design file with the `Departure, and why` header removed: names the table. The real files give no problems in each case.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the checkers were removed or always returned an empty list, every mutated copy would report no problem and tests (a)-(e) would fail; if the real files lacked the rationale or the attribution, the real-file tests would fail.
demonstrations.seam: rationale_problems, readme_attribution_problems and design_attribution_problems are called directly with text; mutated text comes from str::replace on repo_file output. Added by steps 1-2. No double.
